summary: SBC Medical Group Holdings Inc filed an 8-K reporting entry into an underwriting agreement for a secondary offering of 3,100,000 shares of common stock by the CEO as selling stockholder. The company sold no shares and received no proceeds. The offering closed April 21, 2026. Underwriters have a 45-day option for up to 465,000 additional shares. This is a routine shelf takedown under an existing S-3, not a special situation.
